summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/carto-tokens@0.3.6 is published as a design-tokens library (DTCG JSON → vanilla-extract/motion/react-native outputs), but its package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs (obfuscated with _0x-prefixed identifiers and per-function string-lookup objects) downloads a pinned release of the Bun JavaScript runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes that freshly-downloaded Bun binary to execute a sibling file math_init.js shipped inside the tarball. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line @bun-cjs bundle exhibiting the obfuscator.io shape: hex-mangled identifiers, a large numeric/string constant array, and a rotation function (MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())) used to look up strings at runtime. Neither setup.mjs nor math_init.js appears in package.json's `files` manifest (which lists only build/vanilla-extract, build/motion, build/react-native, and README.md), and the README does not mention a runtime bootstrap. A design-tokens package has no functional need for the Bun runtime or for executing an opaque 727KB bundle at install time; the alien-runtime invocation is a mechanism to run install-time code outside any Node-based inspection path, and the obfuscation prevents audit of the payload's behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
